test_matrix.verification: Selects the eligible west-site backup worker with the lowest queue depth.
Worker targeting may pass while backend capability rejection keeps the definition unplaceable with a structured backend reason.
Cordoned, label-mismatched, and capability-mismatched workers each receive structured candidate rejection reasons.
Metadata-defined all_eligible policy returns all eligible worker pubkeys in stable order.
Metadata-defined first_eligible policy selects the lowest worker pubkey deterministically.
Lifecycle capability requirements block placement when no backend resolver is available.
Invalid selection policy metadata is rejected instead of being silently ignored.
A definition with no explicit capability requirements selects only workers advertising the backup workload kind.
